OF A 37 YEAR OLD MALE WITH C\/O FEVER,COUGH SINCE 3 DAYS"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003EA 37 year old male patient,married and has 2 children tractor driver by occupation resident of chityala came with\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS:\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Fever since 3 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Cough since 3 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Loss of appetite since 3 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Blackish discoloration of stools (malena) since 3 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Decreased sleep since 3 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Loose stools since 2 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHOPI :\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic\u0026nbsp; 5 years back\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- 5 years prior to this presentation he had low backache for which he went to a local hospital and had been diagnosed with diabetes type2 and was kept on medication and was adviced to have regular checkups once a month.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOne year later, he experienced severe pain abdomen followed by shortness of breath ,where he was taken to a hospital in hyd and there he was found to have deranged RFT. 2 sessions of hemodialysis was done (indication unknown) .He stayed in hsptl for 8 days and got discharged. From then he was on conservative treatment for 3 years .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter discharge from the hospital he quitted doing his usual work of driving tractor due to the ongoing health issue and was restricted to home\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis wife also reports that he tested positive for covid 1 year ago and recovered.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E6 months back he presented to our casuality with complaints of Facial puffiness, pedal edema pitting type extending up to the knee, decline in urine output and shortness of breath (which progressed from grade 3-4).Pt wife reports that his BP was found to be high and was put on ventilator at the time of admission. 5 sessions of hemodialysis done. He stayed for about 10 days and discharged.As his blood glucose levels were found to be normal on subsequent testings he stopped using OHAs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETill then he was on regular maintainance hemodialysis twice a week and 4 units of PRBC transfusion done in a 6 months period.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe was in his usual state of health until 3 days before admission, where he came for regular dialysis and the nxt day he developed fever with temperature up to 104F and associated shaking chills, dry cough (on and off). He had poor appetite and was eating less than usual and has decreased sleep.on furthur questioning he says that he had blackish discoloration of stools .Also complaints of loose stools since 2 days (3-4 episodes\/day)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPAST HISTORY :\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiagnosed to have DM2 since 5 years (stopped medication 6months back)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHypertensive since 6 months (on tab nicardia 10 mg PO\/OD)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EChronic alcoholic since 10 years,drinks regularly .quitted 4 years back\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPERSONAL align=\"left\"\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite - decreased\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel movements regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDecreased urine OF 65Y\/M WITH WEAKNESS OF LEFT UPPER AND LOWER LIMB"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv\u003EThis is an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of\u0026nbsp; \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECASE\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA \u003Cb\u003E65\u003C\/b\u003E year old man, mason by occupation came to the casuality with\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS :\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EWeakness of left upper and lower limb since 1 month\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS :\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 month back then he developed \u003Cb\u003Eweakness of Left upper and lower limbs\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis earliest recall of events dates back to\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E26\/12\/2020 :\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWhere,on this day he woke up early in the morning at 6am\u0026nbsp; and got up from his bed and started walking towards the washroom, he relieved himself and then came back doing his routine work like every day. As his wife called him for breakfast and when he was having it, suddenly he \u003Cb\u003Efelt weakness in the left upper limbs\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003Eand as he was trying to hold the glass of water for few sips ,and after as he was trying to stand ,he couldnt feel the ground with his left leg\u003C\/b\u003E.The couple immediately called their son who hurried to the scene. Sensing the problem, his son took him to our hospital. He had \u003Cb\u003Eintake of alcohol 180 ml whisky\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003Ethe previous night prior to this presentation. He stayed in hospital for about 1 week\u0026nbsp; and treated conservatively \u003Cb\u003E(tab ecospirin 75mg, clopitab 75mg and atorvastatin 20mg for 2 weeks)\u003C\/b\u003E and was adviced to have physiotherapy of Left Upper and lower limb at home. After 2 weeks of discharge his weakness was resolved and he continued his daily routine work after that.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI redirect the conversation to the current incident and the patient reports that his \u003Cb\u003Eweakness\u0026nbsp; started again since 1 month, which was gradually progressed over a few days from onset(espically left lower limb)\u003C\/b\u003E.On probing further he says, he has the most\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003Edifficulty in getting up from a squatting position, standing up from a chair without support, and while walking he has to stress his other normal lower limb to walk, that to with great difficulty. He also complains of stiffness and dragging type of pain in his left lower limb.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe recalls being delinquent at the age of \u003Cb\u003E20\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003Eyears, when he started \u003Cb\u003Esmoking beedis 1 pack per day regularly and consumed cheap liquor (whisky) 90-180ml regularly\u003C\/b\u003E. He says they relax him after a hard day's work. He furthur says that he quitted consuming alcohol 1 year back and smoking 3 years back.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe was diagnosed to be \u003Cb\u003Ehypertensive since 2 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003Eon routine check up at his village and on regular medication\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003E(tab Amlong 5 mg + tab Atenolol 50 mg OD).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003EFrom 9\u0026nbsp;months he was using tab \u003Cb\u003ETelma 40 mg\/OD\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient is able to respond well to my questions, with appropriate responses. He denies having loss of smell, double vision or loss of sight. He denies having unusual sensations on his face and a difficulty in chewing food. He denies history of drooping of eyelids or drooling of saliva. He also denied deviation of angle of mouth. So do the attendants. No history of change in the timbre of his voice, he denied hoarseness, nasal regurgitation of food and water or a nasal twang to his speech. He is able to swallow well.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPAST HISTORY :\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe was \u003Cb\u003EK\/C\/O HTN since 2 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003Eand was on regular medication (tab Amlong 5 mg + tab Atenolol 50 mg OD).From 9 months he was using tab Telma 40 mg\/OD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a K\/C\/O Dm, CAD,TB, Asthama, Thyroid and transfusions\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPERSONAL
